provenance: Original conservative lexical rules derived from the primary-source inventory researched 2026-10-04. No scanner patterns or code copied.
boundary: Start of input or preceding character outside ASCII alphanumeric, underscore, hyphen, and dot; consume the full candidate body without fixed historical lengths.

rules.scope: Current project/admin and ambiguous legacy secret-key candidates; generic sk- does not attribute an issuer
Legacy/current tokens including variable-length outer installation tokens; checksums are not validated
Default prefixes only; administrator-customized prefixes need context
Secret/restricted/organization keys and webhook signing secrets; publishable prefixes excluded

aws.scope: Conservative complete alphanumeric candidates, including common 20-character IDs; no secret-access-key coverage
